title: Estimated expenses in the Dartmouth proposal, 1955
description: Bar chart. The proposal's estimated expenses, totalling $13,500: six faculty salaries of $1,200 ($7,200); eight travel and rent allowances averaging $300 ($2,400); two graduate-student salaries of $700 ($1,400); secretarial and organisational expense ($850); additional travel ($600); contingencies ($550). Data: McCarthy, Minsky, Rochester and Shannon, A Proposal for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence, 31 August 1955.
heading: DARTMOUTH PROPOSAL · EXPENSES · $13,500
